_note: EXAMPLE: the ExplainEveryday channel's filled-in profile (Hindi explainers, boy host). Copy ideas, not values.
niche: everyday money, science and how-things-work explainers

languages.narration: Hindi (Devanagari script for the voice, Roman Hinglish for the caption line)

voice.supplied_recordings: sometimes (the owner recorded the credit-card film)

taste_rules: male voice (the host is a boy)
NO background music in any film; keep the sound effects (foley, whooshes, stamps, pen sounds, room tone)
ALL on-screen text is English (titles, labels, cards, lockup), even when the narration is Hindi
Hindi films: subtitles = English on top, Devanagari below (the .srt carries the same two lines)
no library sign-off in a channel film (credits go in CREDITS next to the film)
